title: The State of Karnataka v. State of Tamil Nadu & Ors. (with connected appeals of State of Kerala and State of Tamil Nadu)
coram: Dipak Misra, C.J., A.M. Khanwilkar & Amitava Roy, JJ.
docket: Civil Appeal No. 2453 of 2007, with Civil Appeal Nos. 2454 and 2456 of 2007
disposition: Appeals disposed of, modifying the Cauvery Water Disputes Tribunal's water allocation among the riparian States
headnote: Not an electricity case — the landmark Cauvery river inter-State water dispute judgment, adjudicating the appeals from the Cauvery Water Disputes Tribunal's final award under the Inter-State River Water Disputes Act, 1956 and Article 262 of the Constitution, addressing groundwater apportionment, the doctrine of equitable apportionment, and Bangalore's drinking-water needs. Recorded compactly and without exhaustive digest given its complete absence of Supply Code nexus (the Cauvery basin's hydro-electric power generation is not a subject of adjudication in this judgment) and its enormous scale (a multi-hundred-page judgment); noted in this corpus's master citation ledger only because the case was collected among search results for Supply Code-adjacent material.

holding_units.code: Inter-State River Water Disputes Act, 1956; Constitution of India, Article 262
holding_units.clause: Not applicable — interstate river-water apportionment, no Electricity Act/Supply Code provision at issue
holding_units.topic: Cauvery river water allocation among Karnataka, Tamil Nadu, Kerala and Puducherry, modifying the Cauvery Water Disputes Tribunal's final award
holding_units.holding: The Supreme Court modified the Cauvery Water Disputes Tribunal's award, revising the inter-State water-sharing formula (including recognition of Bangalore's drinking-water requirements and groundwater considerations), while broadly upholding the Tribunal's equitable-apportionment framework. No electricity-law question was presented or decided.
holding_units.limiting_facts: Cross-appeals by Karnataka, Tamil Nadu and Kerala against the Cauvery Water Disputes Tribunal's final award (2007) apportioning Cauvery river water among the basin States.
holding_units.flag: Recorded compactly given its complete absence of electricity/Supply Code nexus and enormous scale (a landmark interstate water-dispute judgment); not exhaustively digested against this corpus's doctrinal framework.
